name: Message_Start
comment: ({speaker slot, message}) starts dialogue script `message` (EXF_MESSAGE, EXF_CALL_TELPHONE); does nothing while one is running

name: Message_Task
comment: task started by Message_Start; posts mission event 7 (bit 0x40) when the dialogue ends

name: MissionMgr_Init
comment: clears g_MissionMgr (2 slots), the event queue and the mission globals; starts MissionMgr_Task

name: MissionMgr_Task
comment: per frame: turns posted event codes into mission event bits (g_MissionEventHandlers), then runs the slots

name: Mission_Post
comment: (code) posts an event code to the mission manager queue 0x0076EF9C (docs/SCRIPTS.md, "Events")

name: Mission_RaiseEvent
comment: (bits, 1) sets event bits on every running mission

name: MissionMgr_SetFlags
comment: (bits, on) g_MissionMgr +8 flags

name: Mission_End
comment: (mission id) ends a running mission (EXF_EVENT_END)

name: Mission_Start
comment: (mission id) starts a mission in a free slot (slot 1 for 100/101); returns 1 if it started

name: Mission_FreeSlot
comment: -> a free g_MissionMgr slot or 0

name: Mission_ResetState
comment: (mission id) clears the mission globals and the mission's own story flags (g_MissionFlagRanges); called by Mission_Cleanup

name: JobList_Build
comment: (list 0 = A, 1 = B) -> 0-terminated list of available g_Jobs entries for the job menu

name: Mission_SetResult
comment: (mission id, 2 = done / 3 = failed) stores the 2-bit job result; 2 also sets the cleared bit

name: Job_GetResult
comment: (job index) -> 2-bit result from g_JobResults (0 never, 2 done, 3 failed)

name: Job_IndexOf
comment: (mission id) -> index in g_Jobs or -1

name: Mission_IsJob
comment: (mission id) 1 if it is one of the 50 jobs

name: Jobs_PercentCleared
comment: -> % of the 50 jobs ever cleared (g_JobCleared)

name: Mission_Current
comment: -> the running mission id (slot 1 wins), 0 if none

name: Mission_Cleanup
comment: (slot) after a mission script ends: per-mission cleanup, Mission_ResetState, frees the slot

name: Script_StartBattle
comment: (person or battle id, group) starts a fight from a script (EXF_SET_BATTLE, EXF_SET_BATTLE_PLURAL)

name: Battle_ScriptResult
comment: -> the battle result code EXF_CHECK_ST_BATTLE_END stores (0/1 won, 4/6 lost, 2/3/10/11 other; docs/SCRIPTS.md)

name: Mission_AutoStart
comment: (area) on entering an area: starts every g_AutoMissions entry whose requirements and condition function (g_AutoMissionChecks) allow

name: Mission_TalkStart
comment: (person) when talking to someone: may start g_TalkMissions (20% chance with some people)

name: Mission_FlagTrigger
comment: ({state ptr, s16 flag, u8 mission, u8 step}) starts a mission when its story flag gets set

name: Mission_Unavailable
comment: (mission, chapter, % jobs cleared) 0 if g_MissionReq allows the mission now (plus per-mission special cases)
type: int (int mission, int chapter, int percent)

name: Mission_SlotBusy
comment: (mission) 1 if that mission's slot (0, or 1 for 100/101) is running something

name: ClearCount_Get
comment: -> g_ClearCount, times the game was finished; g_MissionReq min_clears

name: Script_MessageBusy
comment: nonzero while a message or menu is up; blocking commands wait for it

name: Script_PlayerBusy
comment: nonzero while the player can't be interrupted; blocking commands wait for it

name: StoryVar_Sub
comment: (index) g_StoryVars[index] -= 1 if above 0 (EXF_ITEM_DEL)

name: Script_GlobalRegs
comment: -> the global register array EXF_TRANS_REG copies to and from

name: g_Jobs
comment: 50 x {u8 mission id, u8 difficulty 1-5, u16 reward $, u32 title text, u32 description text}: the side jobs (dumps/missions.txt)

name: g_JobListA
comment: 34 u32 mission ids offered by job list A (JobList_Build 0)

name: g_JobListB
comment: 16 u32 mission ids offered by job list B (JobList_Build 1)

name: g_MissionReq
comment: per mission id: {u16 chapter mask, u8 min MissionRank_Get, u8 min % jobs cleared}

name: g_MissionFlagRanges
comment: u32 per mission id: its first story flag; flags [n, next) belong to it and are cleared when it ends

name: g_AutoMissions
comment: 26 u8 mission ids that start by themselves when an area loads (Mission_AutoStart)

name: g_AutoMissionChecks
comment: 26 condition functions (area) -> 0 to start, one per g_AutoMissions entry

name: g_TalkMissions
comment: 2 u32 mission ids (0x58, 0x85) that can start when talking to someone

name: g_MissionEventHandlers
comment: 10 handlers for posted event codes: 0 new mission (bit 1), 1 field tick (bit 8), 4 area loaded (bit 4), 5 bit 0x10, 6 battle over (bit 0x20), 7 message ended (bit 0x40), 9 cleanup

name: g_MissionMgr
comment: mission manager: +0 running count, +4 slot count (2), +8 flags, +0xC/+0x10 current mission ids, two 0x110-byte slots at +0x1C

name: g_JobResults
comment: 13 bytes, 2 bits per job: 0 never, 2 done, 3 failed (saved)

name: g_JobCleared
comment: 13 bytes, 2 bits per job: 2 = ever cleared (saved); Jobs_PercentCleared

name: g_BgMissionScript
comment: script buffer of missions 100 and 101 (slot 1)

name: ClearCount_Inc
comment: g_ClearCount += 1; called once by the ending (0x002AE7A0)

name: g_ClearCount
comment: s32 times the game was finished (saved, last word of save block 0x365AC); unlocks missions 0x54, 0x5B, 0x5C

name: Ending_Task
comment: ending sequence: credits, ClearCount_Inc, Criminal ending

name: Criminal_Rank
comment: (1 Leadership, 2 Cash Flow, 3 Charisma) -> rank 0-6 from the score: 0-20, 21-60, 61-100, 101-140, 141-190, 191-240, 241-255

name: Fighter_HeroId
comment: (fighter) -> the hero template the fighter is (68 Aaron, 107 Raven, 108 Gina, 53 Jason G, 22 Lola, ...) from its person's preset

name: Location_Current
comment: -> the current location id (text 18000 + id: 4 GAS STATION, 7 HARBOR GATE, 17 PLATFORM, 31 HOTEL LOBBY, ...)

name: Area_Current
comment: -> the current area id (same numbering as Location_Current)

name: Hero_CanMeet
comment: (hero 22/53/68/107/108) 1 if that hero can be met here and now; docs/UNLOCKS.md

name: Hero_StartEncounter
comment: (hero) if Hero_CanMeet and not met yet, sets up the hero encounter at their location; docs/UNLOCKS.md

name: Hero_HintState
comment: (?, hero) 0-3: whether / how rumours point to a hero (Hero_CanMeet plus Jason G and Aaron specials)

name: Hero_ScaleToPlayer
comment: (hero) sets the hero person's level to the player's +-2 (minimum 1) and recalculates HP

name: Story_AreaEvents
comment: story events on entering an area, by g_StoryChapter stage; starts hero encounters (stage 7 Jason G; 8 Gina, Raven, Jason G; 9 Raven, Jason G; 10 Aaron, Raven, Jason G)

name: Story_AreaEvents2
comment: more story events by stage: Lola's encounter at stages 5-9, Aaron's flag 0x5F2 at stage 10, mission 0x90 at stage 11

name: Appearance_UpdateFlags
comment: from g_Appearance: flag 0x3FF = brows other than your hero's own, 0x3FD = a category 10 item worn, 0x3FE = category 11, 0x4CE = item 2553, plus 0x514-0x525 for other items

name: Job_PhoneOrdersCaller
comment: -> a random healthy ally from g_PhoneOrderAllies who isn't in the party, or 0 (needs 3 healthy allies); mission 0x4E needs it

name: g_PhoneOrderAllies
comment: 16 u8 person ids job 0x4E (Phone Orders) can use

name: Talk_CurrentPerson
comment: -> the person id the player is talking to

name: JobMenu_Open
comment: job menu: JobList_Build(list B when talking to Melvin, person 106, else list A)

name: Jobs_ResetAll
comment: clears g_JobResults and g_JobCleared; NEW GAME on the title screen

name: Jobs_ResetRun
comment: clears g_JobResults (not g_JobCleared) and flags 0x7EF-0x7F3; the new game after the ending (0x003D5860)

name: Ending_NewGame
comment: after the ending: starts the next playthrough, keeping money and g_JobCleared (Jobs_ResetRun)

name: Area_ChangeTo
comment: (from area, to area) sends the player to another area with its default spawn point (EXF_MOVE_STAGE); special spawn points for a few areas

name: Person_IsPresent
comment: (person id) the byte table 0x0060BBB0[id] is 0; Area_PeopleBase/Area_PeopleLayer skip people for whom it is false

name: Area_SpawnPeople
comment: (phase, list) phase 0 starts, phase 1 steps: spawns the 7 g_AreaPeople entries (type 1 people with 0x00178700, temporary persons 200+ made by Person_Init) and the party

name: Area_People
comment: -> g_AreaPeople

name: Area_BuildPeople
comment: fills g_AreaPeople for the current area from g_PeoplePlacement: the base layer (0), a time/state layer (0-3), the story-stage layer (g_StageLayer), mission layers; then counts the people into g_AreaPeopleCount. Called by Area_Load

name: Area_PeopleBase
comment: (entries) copies 7 placement entries into g_AreaPeople (type 1 only if Person_IsPresent)

name: Area_PeopleLayer
comment: (entries) overlays 7 placement entries: type 4/5 clears the slot, 2/3 copy, 1 copies a person if present, alive, not in the party and not an ally (allies only in their mission)

name: Area_Load
comment: loads an area (stage), calls Area_BuildPeople

name: g_AreaPeople
comment: 7 x 64-byte people/object slots of the current area

name: g_AreaPeopleCount
comment: number of type 1 entries in g_AreaPeople

name: g_PeoplePlacement
comment: pointer to the placement data in RAM: s32 layer offsets[12], each layer an offset per area id (0 = none) to 7 AreaPerson entries; 0x01431EB0 in Daniel's chapter 2 save

name: g_StageLayer
comment: s32[12]: the placement layer of each story stage (stages 1-5 -> 5, which is empty; 6-10 -> 6-10)

name: g_AppearanceItems
comment: s32 count (485), then 0x70-byte records: +0 code (what g_Appearance holds), +4 description text 17xxx, +8 name text 16xxx, +0xC price, +0x48 one value per colour variant

name: Appearance_FindItem
comment: (code) -> the g_AppearanceItems record with that code, or 0

name: g_PresetFlagA
comment: u8 per outfit preset (189); 1 for most; street NPC spawn (0x00176xxx) sets up something extra when 1

name: g_PresetValueB
comment: s16 per outfit preset (189), copied to fighter +0xC at street spawn; 1 for most

name: g_PresetBody
comment: s8 per outfit preset (189; read as g_PersonDefs[601].start_entries[preset - 44] by 0x002F7740): 0 = body from the person's sex, else a body table index + 1

name: NpcSpawn_Step
comment: (phase, request {fighter slot - 2, person, g_AreaPeople slot}) phase 0 starts, then call with 1 until it returns 1: spawns a person walking around (street NPC or party member) with the low-poly street model of their preset (step 1 picks it, step 2 loads it)

name: g_NpcSpawnState
comment: NpcSpawn_Step's step (1 pick the model, 2 load, 3 done)

name: g_NpcSpawnModel
comment: CDATA.XAF entry of the street model being spawned: preset + 7

name: g_NpcSpawnTextures
comment: the 10 texture ids of the street model being spawned, copied from g_StreetTextures

name: g_StreetTextures
comment: s16[189][10]: per outfit preset, the DATA.XAF textures of its street model: 3 shared (3561, 4529, 4729), skin, face and body atlas, pants, top, hair, -1, 0

name: Fighter_UsesPresetModel
comment: (fighter) 1 if the fighter's outfit slots equal its preset's, so the fight model is the prebuilt ARCHIVE.XAF entry = preset number; always 0 for persons 51 and 52 (the cut character editor's slots), whose model is built from the slots

name: Fighter_LoadModel
comment: (phase, slot, flags) loads a fighter's fight model: the prebuilt ARCHIVE.XAF entry of its preset, or (persons 51/52, changed outfits) head pieces from ARCHIVE.XAF combinations, clothes as ARCHIVE.XAF item + 0x3A6, textures from DATA.XAF by the slots' part ids; state in 0x005FFD48 (0x17 = done)
type: int (int phase, int slot, int flags)

name: Xaf_LoadDataTexture
comment: (0, DATA.XAF entry, &handle, 1) starts or finds a texture load

name: Editor_ApplyItem
comment: character editor / dressing: applies an appearance record (its +0x2C group and +0x30 kind pick a list in g_EditorItems, +0x24 the index) to a fighter's outfit

name: g_EditorItems
comment: character editor item lists: [sex * 0xC00 + group * 0x300 + kind * 0x20] = {s16 *items, ...}; items[index] is a g_ItemTable item (e.g. HAIRSTYLE:BALD -> item 23, SLICKED BACK -> 335)
